newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Resources dips on requotation.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Resources dips on requotation.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) dipped on requotation after a one-day suspension in order to announce land and hotels deals.
Around 0155 GMT, the stock was down five cents at 7.80 ringgit on volume of 496,000 traded.
The stock hit a new high for the year at 7.90 on Thursday before it was suspended at 7.85.
MRCB unit Kuala Lumpur Sentral Sdn Bhd on Thursday announced that it has signed an agreement to sell a piece of land to Japan's Daito Trust Construction Co Ltd for 63.4 million ringgit.
Daito is to develop a four-star hotel in the Kuala Lumpur Sentral project in the capital city.
Separately, MRCB signed an agreement to sell another plot in the same project for 87.3 million ringgit to an unidentiied individual foreign investor to build a five-star hotel.
Analysts said the deals gave a boost to the Kuala Lumpur Sentral mini-city plan, and that it would help MRCB to finance the 72-acre project.
"It's a massive project. They have to sell some plots to help the cash flow," said one trader.
